raw_segments.text: When heavenward, holy friendship, thou didst go soaring to seek thy home beyond the sky,
and take thy seat among the saints on high.
It was thy will to leave on earth below thy semblance, and upon it to bestow thy veil,
wherewith at times hypocrisy, parading in thy shape, deceives the eye, and makes its
Friendship, return to us, or force the cheat that wears it now, thy livery to restore,
by aid whereof sincerity is slain.
If thou wilt not unmask thy counterfeit, this earth will be the prey of strife once more,
as when primeval discord held its reign.
